species: mouse (C57BL/6JNifdc); mouse BV2 and N2a cell lines
condition_other: post-cardiac arrest brain injury (potassium chloride-induced cardiac arrest and CPR)
readout_other: 24-h survival; neurological deficit score; open field, beam walking, tail suspension, grip strength and inclined plane tests; HE staining; c-Fos immunostaining; Western blot; proteomics; Fluo-4 calcium imaging
direction_notes: LITUS after CPR increased 24-h survival and neurological recovery, increased c-Fos expression in cortex and amygdala, and reduced IL-1beta, IL-6 and TNF-alpha; effects were abolished by the Piezo1 antagonist GsMTx4.

exposures.label: LITUS 500 kHz after CPR (mice) and after OGD/R (cells)

target.label: The transducer was positioned above the wire between the eye and ear.

timing.protocol_description: 0.3 MPa, 200 tone bursts, 500 kHz, PRF 1 kHz, duty cycle 40 %, sonication duration 300 ms, pulse width 400 us; stimulation interval 10 s, total stimulation 40 min starting 10 min after ROSC. In vitro, the US group received immediate US for 40 min after OGD/R.

source_quotes.n_subjects: The mice were allocated to four groups at random: the sham group $( n = 1 0 )$ , in which mice underwent catheterized only; the CPR group (n $= 2 5 ) ,$ , which experienced CA followed by CPR; the CPR + LITUS group $( n = 2 5 )$ , which were exposed to conditions similar to the CPR group, except for LITUS exposure for 40 min; and the CPR + LITUS + GsMTx4 (GsM, an antagonist of Piezo1, Med Chem Express, HY-P1410, Shanghai, China) group (n = 25), where intracerebroventricular (ICV) injection of GsM was performed 48 h prior to the experiment, while all other procedures were identical to the CPR + LITUS group.
source_quotes.n_sessions_per_subject: After ROSC 10 min, ultrasonic gel was immediately applied to the mouse head to promote acoustic coupling (Supplemental Fig. S1C, D).

flags.reason: 200 tone bursts at 1 kHz PRF would last 200 ms, not the stated 300 ms; text recorded as written.
0.3 MPa stated without saying whether free field or in situ; converted from MPa.
Target described only as position of transducer between eye and ear; BV2 microglia cells received US in vitro with parameters not separately restated, so cultured_glia added to one exposure.
Group sizes given for four groups (sham 10, CPR 25, CPR+LITUS 25, CPR+LITUS+GsM 25); sham and CPR groups were not sonicated. Figure legends report n=8 per group.
Driving electronics named (Rigol generator, Aigtek amplifier) but transducer maker not named.
